mechanism: Indomethacin reduces renal clearance of pyrazinamide and its active metabolite uric acid, while pyrazinamide may increase indomethacin levels through competition for renal tubular secretion and protein binding displacement.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and pyrazinamide efficacy; consider alternative NSAID or use lowest effective indomethacin dose with increased monitoring; assess for gout exacerbation.
